info.title: AI Proctor API
info.description: Read people, projects, timesheets, time, check-in metadata, reports, alerts and time off, and create clients, projects, tasks and manual entries. Webhooks (see `webhooks`) push events as they happen. Authenticate with an org API key (`Authorization: Bearer aip_...`) made by an owner or admin on the dashboard's API page. Times are ISO 8601 with a zone; durations are exact seconds. Every request is recorded in the org's audit log. The API never returns capture images or links to them, window titles, or when a check-in is scheduled. See docs/api/v1.md.

post.summary: Request a manual entry for a person
post.description:
Follows the same rules as the person's own request: pending until their manager decides (approved at once when they need no approval), at most 24 hours, not in the future, a project they are a member of and a task of it, no overlap with their clocked time or other entries (409), nothing in an approved week (409 `day_locked`). The key's creator is the actor in the audit log.

Scope: `time:write`.

post.summary: A week was submitted (or reopened after approval: previous_status approved)
post.description: Sent to every enabled endpoint that subscribed to this event. A 2xx answer within 10 seconds counts as delivered; anything else is retried after 1, 4, 16, 64, 256 and 1024 minutes. When a person is deleted before their event goes out, `data` keeps only ids and `redacted` is true.

parameters.name: X-AIProctor-Event
parameters.description: The event type, e.g. timesheet.approved.

parameters.name: X-AIProctor-Event-Id
parameters.description: The event's id, the same in every retry: dedupe on it.

parameters.name: X-AIProctor-Delivery
parameters.description: This endpoint's delivery of the event.

parameters.name: X-AIProctor-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed.

parameters.name: X-AIProctor-Signature
parameters.description: `v1=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<raw body>` with the endpoint's signing secret.

redacted.description: Present (true) when the person's data was removed.

apiKey.description: An org API key: `aip_` and 43 characters.

approval_required.description: Whether their timesheets and manual entries need their manager's approval.

start_time.description: HH:MM in the shift's time zone.

end_time.description: HH:MM; earlier than start_time for a shift that runs past midnight.

updated_at.description: Same as created_at: shifts are replaced, not changed.

worked_s.description: Counted time, flagged time excluded by a manager left out. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

flagged_s.description: Flagged time that needs review (never deducted automatically). In seconds, exact (never rounded).

excluded_s.description: Time a manager excluded. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

manual_s.description: Approved manual entries. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

Segment.description: A stretch of one person's day on their timesheet.

duration_s.description: end_at - start_at. In seconds, exact (never rounded).
end_at - start_at. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

Checkin.description: A check-in's metadata. Captures are never available through the API.

user_id.description: The person the alert is about.

updated_at.description: Same as triggered_at: alerts don't change.

worked_s.description: Counted, not excluded. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

flagged_s.description: Flagged, not excluded. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

excluded_s.description: Excluded by a manager. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

manual_s.description: Approved manual entries. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

worked_s.description: Counted time. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

flagged_s.description: Flagged time. In seconds, exact (never rounded).

TimeOff.description: A time-off request. The employee's note and the decision note are never returned.

type_name.description: The leave type's name, e.g. Vacation.

paid.description: The type's paid flag when it was asked for.

kind.description: Whole days (first_day..last_day) or part of one day (start_at..end_at).

first_day.description: In the person's time zone when they asked.

last_day.description: Inclusive; the same as first_day for a part day.

start_at.description: Local midnight of first_day, or a part day's start.

end_at.description: Midnight after last_day, or a part day's end.

timezone.description: The person's time zone when they asked.

decided_by.description: Who approved or declined it (the person themselves when approved on asking: someone with no manager).

Holiday.description: A holiday: the whole local day of everyone it applies to.

country.description: ISO country code of the work location it is for; null: everyone.

state.description: US state code, for a US holiday of one state.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable: e.g. missing_key, invalid_key, key_revoked, key_expired, insufficient_scope, invalid_param, rate_limited, not_found, name_taken.

previous_status.description: The status before this change; null for a week created in this state.

WebhookAlert.description: A manager alert. The recipients are not included.

user_id.description: The person the alert is about.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or wrong (`invalid_param`, with `param`).

Unauthorized.description: No key, or a key that is not valid, revoked or expired.

NotFound.description: The id is not in this organization.

Conflict.description: A conflict: a taken name, an overlap or a locked week.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests per minute for the key.
